notes.title: Game development process | 70%
notes.content:
[p][b]Hi everyone![/b]
I want to share some progress updates about the game’s development.[/p][p]First off, a huge thank you to every single one of you who wishlisted the game and is following the development journey. I’ve now sorted out my personal matters and can fully focus on continuing the work. The game is currently [b]around 70% complete[/b].[/p][p]Secondly, as you may have noticed, the game’s cover art has been updated. In fact, it’s not just the cover—we’re currently redrawing [b]all artwork[/b], and you’ll be able to [b]choose your favorite art style[/b] in the game itself![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45542441/189dfe648ef963fd235870d21ee4749ed1a2e949.png"][/img][/p][p]Tomorrow, I’ll be heading to the studio to record a song for the game, which will play during one of its key story moments. Also, if you enjoy the game and it gains significant popularity—or if I receive strong, encouraging feedback from you wanting a continuation—I’ll start developing [b]Chapter 2[/b] right away![/p]
